senses.gloss:
ITA-1.6.29 vidhānam विधानम्
Sequential narration or enumeration
The narration of a topic in the correct logical sequence.

ITA-1.5.7 vidhiḥ विधिः
Mandatory injunction
An instruction or procedure stipulated in a text.

ITA-4.5.20 vidhisamprāptiḥ विधिसम्प्राप्तिः
Classification-based pathogenesis
Pathogenesis subclassification based on various prognostic aspects such as whether a disease or condition can be classified as easily curable, incurable or difficult to cure.

ITA-3.16.46 vidhurā (marma) विधुरा (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) in the depression behind the ear
Two in number (one on each side) which when injured leads to loss of hearing.
